You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important to the failure of the Schlieffen Plan was Russia’s mobilisation in 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the impact of conscription in shaping civilian life on the British Home Front?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the Weimar Constitution in creating instability in Germany, 1919–33? Explain
your answer.
How significant were the churches in the opposition to Nazi rule after 1933? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was agriculture as a cause of Russia’s problems by March 1917? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was War Communism in the consolidation of Bolshevik rule to 1924? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the availability of electricity as a reason for economic growth in the USA in the
1920s? Explain your answer.
How significant was Prohibition in changing the lives of the American people, 1919–33? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Yenan Soviet in increasing support for the Chinese Communist Party by
1949? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were improved relations with the USA in establishing China as a superpower by
the time of Mao’s death? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were the Land Acts in shaping the lives of the non-white population in South Africa
before 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was anti-communism as a motive for the government’s repression of political
opponents in South Africa to 1966? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the Yom Kippur War (1973) in shaping Arab–Israeli relations up to 1996?
Explain your answer.
How significant has the peacekeeping and diplomacy of the United Nations been in attempts to
resolve the Arab–Israeli conflict? Explain your answer. [40]
